description: Synthetic project-memory retrieval judgments; authored before candidate execution. No consumer project data. Files are generic reference targets, not symbol-search labels.

records.title: Recover a corrupt SQLite index
records.body: SQLite CORRUPT and NOTADB indicate a damaged disposable index. Close its connection before removing database, WAL and SHM files, then rebuild from Markdown. Повреждённый индекс SQLite восстанавливаем из Markdown.

records.title: Preserve storage on operational errors
records.body: Busy, readonly and permission failures do not authorize removal of an existing database. Retry within a bounded budget or use file-backed retrieval. Не удалять базу при ошибке доступа или блокировке.

records.title: Rebuild the disposable catalog
records.body: Run the index command. Parse authoritative Markdown and discover source symbols, publish the catalog atomically in one transaction. Индекс можно пересобрать из файлов.

records.title: Freshness of context packs
records.body: A context pack checks file size and modification time on every request. Additions, edits and deletions must be visible even inside ordinary search's one-second interval. Свежесть контекста проверяется при каждом запросе.

records.title: Cache dependency invalidation
records.body: Cache keys cover selected files, project configuration and playbooks. Changed dependencies invalidate the saved pack. Кэш сбрасывается при изменении зависимостей.

records.title: Store record metadata in the catalog
records.body: Keep frontmatter fields alongside body text. Rank candidate records before reading only the selected Markdown excerpts, avoiding repeated parsing of every document.

records.title: Markdown fallback when index storage is unavailable
records.body: If index storage cannot be used, read authoritative files with the same module aliases, global inclusion, archive choice and duplicate precedence. Return a warning and disable caching. При недоступности базы читать Markdown.

records.title: Canonical module names and aliases
records.body: The engine alias resolves to router. Include global records alongside scoped records. Other modules remain outside the candidate set.

records.title: FTS5 query experiment
records.body: Evaluate full-text MATCH with BM25. Token matching differs from substring retrieval. Quote user text to neutralize SQL full-text operators and punctuation before MATCH.

records.title: Code identifier tokenization
records.body: resolveModuleName and buildContextPack are complete identifiers. Underscores, hyphens and substrings need deliberate handling; lexical engines do not automatically split every camelCase name.

records.title: Explicit relationships between memory records
records.body: Use source_task and related record IDs. Expand one hop in both directions, within the already selected module and archive scope. Relationships are evidence pointers, not semantic embeddings.

records.title: Evaluate retrieval quality
records.body: Author relevance judgments before candidate runs. Compare hit@5, recall@5, MRR@5, negative-query behavior, latency and returned context volume. Набор запросов проверяет качество поиска.

records.title: Retrieval experiment measurements
records.body: Warm samples exclude index construction. Record p50 and p95, dataset hash and source digest. These measurements concern a small synthetic corpus, not production scaling.

records.title: Index schema migration
records.body: A schema version change requires rebuilding derived metadata and invalidating old pack-cache entries. Do not treat outdated cached metadata as current truth.

records.title: Concurrent index writers
records.body: WAL permits readers while a writer commits. BEGIN IMMEDIATE and busy_timeout bound contention between hooks and agents. Timeout is an operational failure.

records.title: Archive completed project memory
records.body: Completed tasks and old verification evidence may move to archive. Superseded decisions are archived rather than deleted. Историю решений сохранять в архиве.

records.title: Redact secret-like assignments
records.body: Scrub credentials before excerpts enter agent context. Replace suspicious assignments with a redaction marker. Не передавать секреты в контекст.

records.title: Repository file boundary
records.body: Reject absolute workstation paths, parent traversal and symbolic links resolving outside the repository. Only repository files may be loaded as context.

records.title: Package contents check
records.body: The npm tarball contains launchers, compiled runtime, documentation and templates. Exclude node_modules, generated indexes, credentials and project-specific records.

records.title: Built-in database dependency
records.body: Use node:sqlite from the supported runtime. Avoid native addon compilation during installation. Verify optional full-text support on each runtime build.

records.title: Agent hook capture
records.body: Session boundaries produce reviewable drafts. Suppress recursive captures of injected context and keep hot-path work bounded. Хуки сохраняют черновики для проверки.

records.title: Corporate TLS certificate trust
records.body: Launch Node with the configured system certificate authority. Preserve certificate verification when calling a corporate HTTPS endpoint.

records.title: Confirm a Task Contract before implementation
records.body: State goal, scope, exclusions, acceptance criteria, risks and verification plan. User authorization confirms the requested scope. Перед реализацией подтвердить контракт задачи.

records.title: Files remain authoritative
records.body: SQLite is a derived, disposable index. Original Markdown and YAML records remain authoritative. A ranking score is not proof of runtime behavior.

records.title: Porter stemming prototype
records.body: The historical porter stemming experiment transformed English inflections. This document is retained as archive evidence, not a current requirement.

records.title: Vector embeddings proposal
records.body: An unconfirmed proposal to compare semantic embedding retrieval. It is not implemented or an approved architecture decision.

records.title: SQLite query language reference
records.body: SQLite supports SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE. The SQL syntax reference has no recovery policy for a damaged context index.

records.title: Browser cache freshness
records.body: A browser validates image cache entries with HTTP headers. This concerns static web assets rather than record pack dependencies.

records.title: Dependency lockfile updates
records.body: A dependency lockfile pins installation versions. It does not manage database writer contention.

records.title: Secret menu documentation
records.body: A fictional cafe secret menu contains seasonal recipes. This is unrelated to credential redaction.

records.title: Graph chart colors
records.body: A chart uses bars and axes to draw evaluation data. This graph has no record relationships.

records.title: Archive extraction guide
records.body: Extract a zip archive into an installation directory. This is unrelated to retention of completed task memory.

records.title: Recover SQLite busy readonly corrupt database: retired prototype
records.body: This obsolete prototype removed every database for any error. It was retired because operational failures must preserve storage. This historical record is not the maintained recovery policy.

records.title: Database cache migration metadata query checklist
records.body: A generic checklist mentions many popular terms without specifying repository memory behavior. Cache cache cache metadata metadata database database migration migration. It contains neither an implementation decision nor an operational procedure.

records.title: Corruption word frequency sample
records.body: corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption corruption. This is a token-frequency sample for a linguistics exercise, not instructions for index repair.

records.title: Schema migration endpoint cache
records.body: An unrelated sample endpoint returns the schema name of an upstream service. It does not upgrade the local record catalog or invalidate saved context packs.

records.title: ModuleName option glossary
records.body: ModuleName is an unrelated glossary heading used by a fictional calculator. It does not describe resolveModuleName, camelCase token boundaries or the identifier retrieval experiment.

records.title: Graph relationships handoff and source_task vocabulary
records.body: A vocabulary list mentions verification and relationships but defines no record edges. Similar words are not proof of a supported graph traversal contract.

records.title: Native SQLite addon installation: retired option
records.body: An old proposal required compiling an addon during npm install. It was retired; current packaging uses the supported runtime's built-in database module.

records.title: Historical alternative full-text engine note
records.body: This archived note recorded an abandoned external full-text service. It is not the current local FTS5 experiment.

queries.rationale: Operational errors, degraded reads and corruption classification matter; the retired delete-everything prototype does not answer the maintained-policy request.

queries.query: After an editor saves a record and another record is deleted, the same context query is called within one second: which rule ensures the answer and its cached dependencies are still current?
queries.rationale: Immediate freshness and dependency invalidation, not browser cache terminology.

queries.query: The catalog schema changes while there are old saved packs; do we need to rebuild metadata and invalidate those caches before ranking selected excerpts?
queries.rationale: Three local catalog/cache policies are relevant; an upstream schema endpoint is a hard negative.

queries.query: For installation portability I want the current decision about avoiding native compilation during npm install, plus the check that excludes generated context indexes from the tarball
